high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for a limited period offer of a brown leather duffel bag with white stripes. The setting appears to be a modern, minimalist room with a clean and organized aesthetic. The background features a geometric patterned wall with hexagonal and triangular designs in shades of gray, black, and white. Below the wall, there is a wooden countertop with a sleek, contemporary design, and a white cabinet with a sliding door. The main focus of the image is the brown leather duffel bag, which is placed on the floor.
